item.title: GPT-6 Astra raises the stakes: faster work, tighter trust.
item.description: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra, describing it as its “most capable model for business,” with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing/design judgment. OpenAI also published a Safety overview noting GPT-6 Astra reached the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under its Preparedness Framework. Why it matters: If you’re using AI to write, design, or run workflows, you’re also moving closer to systems that can materially affect enterprise security and thus brand trust. Watch: What

item.title: Signal Current — 2026-09-08: AI is getting cheaper, but trust is the real cost center
item.description: This week’s big tension: capability is advancing fast, yet the reputational and operational risk is still what leaders have to govern—not what models can do. OpenAI is explicitly pitching more capable, more affordable AI “within reach,” while also expanding journalism support and rolling out new model/safety work—raising the stakes for how brands and agencies operationalize reliability, attribution, and cyber hygiene.
